title: Aligning Crowd Feedback via Distributional Preference Reward modelling

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating diverse annotator personas (varying by age, occupation, and personality, such as "strict expert scientist" or "impulsive teenager") using an LLM to generate a distribution of human preferences. The paper then evaluates the model's helpfulness and harmlessness win rates across these varied personas to measure its alignment with broader population-level preferences rather than a single, skewed annotator perspective.
